mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 1.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low UNRATE (< 4%) signals a strong labor market, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% and HOUST increases by > 5% over the same month, it signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Regime-conditional: during post-shock recovery, a RSAFS increase > $50B signals strengthening consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 18-month rolling window during post-shock recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: CPIAUCSL growth below 2% indicates contained inflation, contributing to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward SPX returns during low-inflation periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances.
